component.name: AI Chat
component.summary: A desktop chat window for Claude Code

description.p: AI Chat puts the Claude Code command line into a proper window: live progress while Claude works, a project folder per chat, saved chats you can reopen and export as Markdown, and Read only, Edit files or Full auto permission modes.
Dark, light and system themes. Requires the separate claude command. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Anthropic.
